title: Tra2beta exerts tumor-promoting effects via GSK3/beta-catenin signaling in oral squamous cell carcinoma.
authors: Wu, Xiaofen; Zhou, Xinyue; Sun, Xiaozhen; Ning, Yi; Song, Xiaona; Song, Guohua; Guo, Xiaohong; Sun, Rui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究剪接因子Tra2beta在口腔鳞癌中的促癌作用及GSK3/β-catenin信号通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: The splicing factor transformer-2 homolog beta (Tra2beta) plays a pivotal role in various cancers. Nonetheless, its role in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) has not been comprehensively explored. This study sought to discern the influence of Tra2beta on OSCC and its underlying mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We assessed Tra2beta expression in OSCC utilizing immunohistochemistry, qRT-PCR, and western blotting techniques. siRNA transfection was used to silence Tra2beta. Whole transcriptome RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) analysis was carried out to reveal the alternative splicing (AS) events. KEGG pathway analysis enriched the related pathways. Colony formation, transwell, wound healing, and Annexin V-FITC/PI were employed to appraise the consequences of Tra2beta silencing on OSCC. RESULTS: Tra2beta was highly expressed in both OSCC tissues and cell lines. Knockdown of Tra2beta-regulated AS events with skipped exon (SE) accounts for the highest proportion. Meanwhile, downregulation of Tra2beta reduced cell proliferation, migration, and invasion, however increasing cell apoptosis. Moreover, Wnt signaling pathway involved in the function of Tra2beta knockdown which was demonstrated directly by a discernible reduction in the expression of GSK3/beta-catenin signaling axis. CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest that knockdown of Tra2beta may exert anti-tumor effects through the GSK3/beta-catenin signaling pathway in OSCC.
abstract_zh: 目的：剪接因子 transformer-2 同源物 beta（Tra2beta）在多种癌症中发挥关键作用。然而，其在口腔鳞状细胞癌（OSCC）中的作用尚未被全面探讨。本研究旨在阐明 Tra2beta 对 OSCC 的影响及其潜在机制。材料与方法：我们利用免疫组织化学、qRT-PCR 和 western blotting 技术评估了 OSCC 中 Tra2beta 的表达。使用 siRNA 转染沉默 Tra2beta。进行了全转录组 RNA 测序（RNA-seq）分析以揭示可变剪接（AS）事件。KEGG 通路分析富集了相关通路。采用集落形成、transwell、伤口愈合和 Annexin V-FITC/PI 实验评估 Tra2beta 沉默对 OSCC 的影响。结果：Tra2beta 在 OSCC 组织和细胞系中均高表达。敲低 Tra2beta 调控的 AS 事件中，外显子跳跃（SE）占比最高。同时，Tra2beta 下调减少了细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，但增加了细胞凋亡。此外，Wnt 信号通路参与了 Tra2beta 敲低的功能，这通过 GSK3/beta-catenin 信号轴表达的显著降低直接得到证实。结论：这些发现表明，在 OSCC 中敲低 Tra2beta 可能通过 GSK3/beta-catenin 信号通路发挥抗肿瘤作用。
